ShortDescription.Value: Remembers tool panel settings per savegame (tool mode, snapping, elevation...) with configurable sharing scope.

LongDescription.Value:
# **Tool Mode Memory**（中文在下面）
The goal of **Tool Mode Memory** is simple: make tool operation smoother and more seamless, so that after switching assets or loading a save, you do not have to keep reconfiguring the same commonly used tool options over and over again.
If you are getting annoyed because you keep toggling "Snap to Road" on and off while placing props and parks, if you are tired of constantly readjusting the height step precision when building interchanges, if you want every road to start in curve mode instead of having to click it every time, and if you are frustrated by having to set up all of these tools again every time you load a save, then this mod is your lifesaver.
### **Features**
1. Supports real-time memory of each tool option’s shared scope based on configuration. Available scopes: **Same Group / Same Menu / Same Category / Global Shared / Completely Separate**
2. Automatically saves by save name and restores settings on the next load
3. Currently compatible with the 3 tool items added by the **ANARCHY** mod: the anarchy toggle, left/right road upgrade, and the general tool
A simple example: in the vanilla game, **Height** is shared by menu. That means if you raise a two-lane road to 10 m, switching to a four-lane or eight-lane road will still keep it at 10 m. With this mod, you can change it to be shared only within the same group, so when you switch to a four-lane or eight-lane road, it stays at 0 m.
### **How to Use**
1. Subscribe to and enable the mod.
2. Enter the game and use roads, buildings, zones, and other tools as you normally would.
3. If the behavior feels unfamiliar, adjust the shared scope in the mod settings to match your preference.
4. If you only want settings to be restored from the last time you quit the game, and do not want to change the shared scope rules, you can set all tool items’ shared scope back to the vanilla behavior.
Turning the master switch off = completely vanilla behavior. Functions such as **Reset Memory** and **Manage Memory Files for All Saves** can be found under the **About** section in the options menu.
### **Compatibility**
This mod does not change any in-game behavior, so it should not conflict with other mods. It currently supports memory for tool items added by the **ANARCHY** mod, and more mod support may be added in the future.
If you run into any functional or performance issues, feel free to report them in the discussion area.

## **中文**
**Tool Mode Memory** 的目标很简单：把工具操作变得更连贯、更顺手，让你在切换资产、读档之后，不必反复把常用工具项重新调一遍。
如果你在摆件和公园之间因为反复开关“对齐路边”而感到烦躁， 如果你修建立交时总是要来回调整高度变化的精度， 如果你希望所有道路都能直接按曲线模式摆放，而不是每次都要点一下， 如果你苦恼每次读档都要重头设置一遍这些工具， 那么这个模组是你的救星。
### **功能**
1、支持按配置 实时记忆每个工具项的共用范围，配置方式支持 同组 / 同菜单 / 同类资产 / 全局共用 / 全部不共用 2、按存档名称自动保存，下次读档自动恢复 3、目前已兼容ANARCHY模组的3个工具项（anarchy开关、左侧和右侧道路升级、常规工具）
举个简单例子，原版游戏中，高度是同菜单共用的，也就是你摆放两车道道路抬高到10m，那么切换到四车道、八车道依然还是10m。而模组可以让你实现只在同组内共用，即切换到四车道、八车道还是0m。
### **使用方法**
1. 订阅并启用模组。 2. 进入游戏后像平时一样使用道路、建筑、区域等工具。 3. 如果感到不习惯，在模组选项界面按你的习惯调整共用范围。 4. 如果你只希望每次读档能恢复上次退出游戏时的设置，并不需要改写共用范围，可以将全部工具项的共用范围调整回原版。
总开关关闭 = 完全原版行为。重置记忆、管理所有存档的记忆文件等功能都在选项界面的「关于」。
### **兼容性**
模组不改变游戏内的任何行为，所以不会和其它模组产生冲突。目前已支持记忆ANARCHY模组添加的工具项，未来会支持更多模组。
如果你碰到功能或性能上的问题，可以在讨论区反馈。

PublishConfiguration.ChangeLog:
v0.9.0
* The mod now starts switched off, so a fresh install changes nothing until you turn it on. The three per-page switches start on, so once you enable the mod it simply works. * The two kinds of switch now do clearly different things. The per-page switches control memory: on means settings are recorded as you work and restored when you load a save, off means nothing is recorded or restored. The per-item switches only control the sharing scope, so turning one off just greys out its scope dropdown and leaves that row to vanilla. * Every description has been rewritten to be short and readable, with line breaks where the meaning splits. Implementation detail that players do not need is gone. * Sharing scope no longer offers "Same type" on the Functions and Items pages. Vanilla only remembers NetTool settings, and it buckets them by the asset category, so on those two pages the "vanilla" option did not mean anything and the grouping mixed unrelated tool modes. Buildings & Services keeps it, since grouping by what an asset serves is what vanilla effectively does. * Functions and Items pages no longer carry recommendations at all: every item there starts off and follows vanilla. On the Buildings & Services page Tool Mode now recommends "Same type", Elevation is unchanged, and Parallel Mode no longer recommends anything. * Fixed the Colour item: it was reading the road custom colour, which the panel never shows, while the Color row belongs to route tools. It now remembers the colour row that route tools actually display. * Your existing memories are kept: every memory bucket keeps its old name, so values recorded by earlier versions are read back unchanged.
中文
* 模组出厂改为关闭：刚装好时什么都不改变，你主动打开才生效。三个分页开关出厂是打开的，所以一旦启用模组就能直接用。 * 两类开关的分工现在很清楚。分页开关管记忆：打开就实时记录、读档自动恢复；关掉就不记录也不恢复。每一项自己的开关只管共用范围，关掉只是把它的共用范围灰掉，这一行交回原版。 * 所有说明文本重写，短、好读，该换行的地方都换行，去掉玩家不需要的实现细节。 * 共用范围在功能页与道具页不再提供「同类」。原版只记忆道路工具的设置，而且是按资产分类分组的，所以在功能页与道具页「原版」这一档没有意义，按同类归组还会把不同工具的模式混在一起。建筑与服务页保留它，因为「按这件资产服务谁」正是原版实际在做的事。 * 功能页与道具页不再有推荐：那一页每一项都出厂关闭、按原版行为走。建筑与服务页里工具模式改为推荐「同类」，高度不变，并列模式去掉推荐。 * 修复「颜色」一项：以前读的是道路的自定义配色，而面板上根本不显示那一行；「颜色」这一行属于路线工具。现在记忆路线工具真正显示的那个颜色。 * 以前的记忆不丢：每个记忆桶的名字一个都没改，旧版本记下的值照旧读得回。
